description: Heuristic static scan of one directory inside the workspace root for AI client calls that are not passed through withSpurvik, spurvikMiddleware, withSpurvikMastra, withSpurvikModel, withSpurvikModelProvider, withSpurvikLangGraph, or spurvikInterrupt. A StateGraph constructor is reported when the file does not call withSpurvikLangGraph. A bare interrupt() call is reported when the file does not call spurvikInterrupt or resolveLangGraphInterrupts. The scan reads .ts, .tsx, .js, .jsx, .mjs, .cjs, .mts, and .cts files. It does not read .md or .mdc files. Results are file:line. The line number is 1-based and counts every newline, including comments and strings. This is a heuristic, so it can miss a call or report one that is already wrapped. The scan does not change files and does not use the network. Paths that leave the workspace, including '..', are rejected. The scanner skips files named .env or .env.* (any case), including through symlinks and hard links. Over HTTP there is no workspace directory. Pass code (a string, max 128 KB) or files (an array of { path, content }). If neither is passed, this tool explains that, and how to run the local stdio MCP server or /spurvik:check for a directory scan.

code.description: Inline TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python source code (up to 128 KB) to inspect for unwrapped LLM SDK calls.

files.description: Array of project source files ({ path, content }) to inspect in memory for unwrapped OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Vercel AI SDK, or LangChain calls.

content.description: UTF-8 source text of the file (inspected in memory only, never persisted).

path.description: Relative file path (for example, src/chat.ts or app/main.py).

name: spurvik_find_unwrapped_calls
